sources.title: Codex documentation index
sources.notes: Read the public documentation index. Use it to resolve current canonical pages; entries span several product surfaces.

sources.title: ChatGPT and Codex changelog
sources.notes: Read the canonical HTML changelog or its /rss.xml feed. The .md endpoint returned 404 during this audit. Discovery extracts bounded recent desktop/Codex-related product announcements one feature at a time; CLI, mobile and model-only release entries are excluded. Public announcements do not establish availability in the local app.

sources.title: ChatGPT and Codex features
sources.notes: Read the feature navigation page. It is an entry point, not evidence that a selected account or installed build exposes every listed feature.

sources.title: Browser
sources.notes: Read browser guidance, including profile/session separation. Browser access does not establish native-app control or identical authentication state.

sources.title: Computer Use
sources.notes: Read setup, platform and app-access guidance. Availability and access controls must be tested in the actual connected provider.

sources.title: Codex App Server
sources.notes: Read thread lifecycle and protocol sections. Public app-server methods explain contracts; they are not DSH APIs or evidence of desktop UI layout.

sources.title: Build skills
sources.notes: Read skill authoring guidance. Use for source workflow discovery; DSH packaging and loading require separate verification.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol
sources.notes: Read transport and configuration guidance. Use the active server schemas rather than copying a documentation example into another host.

sources.title: REA repository
sources.notes: Read README target categories and setup overview. Project links and release compatibility must be rechecked before acquiring dependencies.

sources.title: REA research skill
sources.notes: Read the public raw skill. Useful for routing target types; repository main may describe tools absent from a published release. OpenCodex guidance is authored separately.

sources.title: REA evidence workflows
sources.notes: Read evidence identity, paging and bounded reconstruction guidance. A reported pass covers its declared claims, not universal behavioral equivalence.

sources.title: REA JavaScript application workflows
sources.notes: Read public application graph and version-comparison documentation. Static relations and observed execution have different evidentiary scope.

sources.title: REA runtime observation reference
sources.notes: Read the runtime reference. Use only declared target/actions and the currently available provider; no assumption that a prohibited target becomes accessible through REA.

sources.title: REA DSH Cordis adapter
sources.notes: Read the public DSH integration source. Source presence does not prove that the installed REA release or local DSH configuration includes this adapter.

sources.title: REA MCP contracts
sources.notes: Read the public MCP contract document. Runtime tools/list remains authoritative for accepted fields and available tools.

sources.title: DeepSeek Harness repository
sources.notes: Read the public repository README. Pin compatible published package versions; a moving branch is not a released dependency contract.

sources.title: DSH UI slots
sources.notes: Read the public slot subsystem document. Confirm ownership, registration and disposal in the installed version before overriding a surface.

sources.title: DSH plugin manager
sources.notes: Read public plugin management documentation. Installation/lifecycle checks still need a real compatible DSH runtime.

sources.title: DSH native CUA provider
sources.notes: Read the public experimental provider README. Platform labels describe investigation targets, not verified provider support on every OS; inspect prerequisites on the selected host.

sources.title: Electron ASAR Archives
sources.notes: Read ASAR format and filesystem behavior guidance. A package inventory explains container structure, not application execution.

sources.title: Playwright visual comparisons
sources.notes: Read screenshot comparison guidance. Reference/candidate environment consistency matters; snapshot success alone does not establish behavior.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA combobox pattern
sources.notes: Read the combobox interaction pattern. Use where the session chooser actually behaves as a combobox; do not impose this role on unrelated UI.

sources.title: Codex asynchronous compaction implementation
sources.notes: Background candidate and provider capability checks inspected. This is source evidence, not proof of desktop/account availability. Pin the actual commit during feature research.
